title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin slipped 0.8 percent to close at 77,256 dollars as US markets wrapped, holding the line above 77k despite light selling pressure. Greed index at 66 shows buyers still in control even as volume stayed muted. Hashrate printed a solid 945.9 EH/s, underscoring network strength while the mempool cleared 76k transactions at a rock-bottom one sat per vbyte fee.
